sequences.name: New lead follow-up
sequences.description: Call and follow up with new leads.

sequences.name: Discovery follow-up
sequences.description: Recap discovery and set the next task.

sequenceTemplates.name: Initial outreach
sequenceTemplates.subject: A quick idea for you
sequenceTemplates.preview: Introduce the reason for reaching out and connect it to the record.
sequenceTemplates.body:
Hi {{name}},

I wanted to share a quick idea that may be useful to you.

Would you be open to a short conversation this week?

Best,
The sales team

sequenceTemplates.name: Follow-up
sequenceTemplates.subject: Following up
sequenceTemplates.preview: A short, direct follow-up when the previous email has no reply.
sequenceTemplates.body:
Hi {{name}},

I wanted to follow up on my previous note.

Would it be useful to discuss this, or is there someone else I should speak with?

Best,
The sales team

sequenceTemplates.name: Meeting invitation
sequenceTemplates.subject: A time to connect
sequenceTemplates.preview: Invite the contact to a conversation with a clear reason to meet.
sequenceTemplates.body:
Hi {{name}},

I would like to set up a short conversation with you.

Would you have time to connect this week?

Best,
The sales team

sequenceTemplates.name: Post-call recap
sequenceTemplates.subject: Recap and next steps
sequenceTemplates.preview: Summarise the conversation and make the next step explicit.
sequenceTemplates.body:
Hi {{name}},

Thanks for your time today. Here is a quick recap of our conversation.

Next step: I will follow up with the information we discussed.

Best,
The sales team

sequenceTemplates.name: Proposal
sequenceTemplates.subject: Your proposal
sequenceTemplates.preview: Share the proposal and explain what the contact should do next.
sequenceTemplates.body:
Hi {{name}},

I am sharing the proposal we discussed.

Please take a look and let me know if you would like to review it together.

Best,
The sales team

sequenceTemplates.name: Final check-in
sequenceTemplates.subject: Should I close the loop?
sequenceTemplates.preview: A respectful final note that gives the contact an easy way to respond.
sequenceTemplates.body:
Hi {{name}},

I have not heard back, so I wanted to check in one last time.

Should I close the loop for now, or would you still like to continue the conversation?

Best,
The sales team
